verdict.rationale: There is no documented native bulk-edit feature. Bulk operations are possible only indirectly, by scripting loops against the local HTTP API, which dispatches any plugin-API method through POST /api with bearer auth, or by writing plugins. Queries can gather many matching items, but nothing shows acting on them in bulk. Missing for 10: a first-class bulk-operation or batch-edit capability, a batch API endpoint, documented examples of acting on query results across many items, and hands-on corroboration.
